method: Eight new unauthenticated Chrome contexts. 3D dependency requests deliberately held to isolate decorative Canvas2D from GPU scene work. The actual deployed decorative canvas was sampled after fonts/poster loaded and again 1500ms later. 5-CSS-pixel grid cell center occupancy is compared across DPR and motion; screenshots saved at CSS scale. This is decorative behavior evidence, not live-3D interaction verification.
